messages:
Ava: quick sync request 1 - we need a concrete handoff spec for per-route/per-model SLO dashboards in Console. P50/P95/P99 + TTFT + tokens/sec. Can runtime/infra list exact metric names and labels we can rely on?
Ben: runtime exports request_latency_ms (histogram) and first_token_latency_ms (histogram). labels: model, model_version, route, env, deployment_id. also emit request_event{fallback_reason}.
Carla: infra has gpu_tokens_emitted_total and active_request_concurrency gauge. labels: deployment_id, region. we avoid customer_id due to cardinality/privacy.
Danielle: Console needs: route-level default view (p50/p95/p99 + TTFT + tokens/sec), model-compare view, selectable windows (1m/5m/1h/24h), and SLO burn-rate visualization. TTFT heatmap would be huge value.
Ben: note TTFT = time from inbound to first token write, we already instrument first_token_latency_ms. will ensure it's available as a recording rule input.
Eli: request: please keep model_version label on metrics (not just alias) so ML can correlate perf regressions. Also request low-rate sampling of full traces for very high latency requests.
Frank: can we agree SLI definitions? Propose p95 latency per-route over 5m rolling window (server-side), p99 as alerting signal; TTFT p95 over 1m for UX; throughput = tokens/sec per route+model.
Ava: agree with Frank. Also product asks that default panels aggregate by route->model_version, with an opt-in "deployment breakdown" toggle.
Carla: implementation notes: infra will add recording rules in prometheus-prod. We'll precompute quantiles to reduce load. Proposed rule snippet:
```
- record: request_latency_p95_ms
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model_version))
```
We'll also emit derived metric tokens_per_request with labels (route, model_version) to simplify tokens/sec. Raw histograms retained 7d, recordings 30d.
Ben: runtime caution: combining route+model_version+deployment_id explodes cardinality. Recommend Console default drop deployment_id; keep it available for drilldowns.
Danielle: Console will hide deployment-level chips by default and provide a toggle. will wireframe model-comparison (side-by-side time series + ratio view) and send link.
Frank: alerting thresholds (prelim): page when p99 > 2000ms for 5m on production routes OR TTFT p95 > 800ms for 1m. Add burn-rate alert to warn before paging.
Eli: for regressions, we also want sample_count and median+IQR panels for each route to avoid chasing noisy p95 on very low QPS routes.
Ava: rollout UX: dashboards should surface canary vs stable comparisons, and annotate fallback events (labels: fallback_reason). Also flag automatic fallbacks as annotations.
Ben: runtime will emit request_event{fallback_reason="out_of_capacity|latency_shed|manual"} and a trace event on first_token_emitted to tie TTFT to traces. PR will add normalizing labels.
Carla: infra PR will include recording rules and a small derived metric pipeline to compute tokens/sec per (route, model_version). We can also provide a pre-aggregated timeseries for Console to fetch.
Danielle: Console acceptance: panels for p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec; model-compare view; fallback annotations; CSV export. I'll own Console tickets. Expect infra PR by EOD Wed and runtime changes by Thu.
Frank: oncall runbook update: if p99 spike -> check fallback annotations -> check deployment_id -> escalate to runtime. I'll add smoke queries to the playbook after recordings land.
Ava: acceptance criteria for handoff: 1) recording rules in infra repo, 2) Console panels implemented, 3) model-compare + fallback annotations, 4) docs for label semantics and cardinality limits. added GH epic.
deploy-bot: Deployed new metrics to prometheus-prod at 2028-05-12T14:32:10Z
Ben: quick FYI - migration job running to backfill model_version for historical metrics.
Carla: infra PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/changes/6790 (recording rules + retention + tokens_per_request).
Ben: runtime PR: https://git.internal/r/runtime/changes/1235 (first_token_event + label normalization).
Danielle: wireframes posted: https://figma.internal/console/slo-dashboards - feedback welcome.
Eli: adding 1% sampling probe for high-latency traces, configurable per-team.
Ava: thanks team. next review Friday 10:00 to validate queries and panels. :thumbsup:
